meta.disclaimer: Save numbers offline before remote drives. Private medical evacuation is via your travel insurer — national ambulance services vary in rural response times.
meta.sourceLabel: National emergency services, AA, and tourism operator hotlines

intro: Breakdowns on gravel happen. Store these numbers in your phone and on a printed sheet — signal drops exactly where you need help.
insuranceReminder: Your travel insurance emergency line covers medical evacuation (Medivac to Johannesburg or Nairobi). For vehicle recovery, use AA or rental company roadside cover — generic travel insurance usually excludes mechanical breakdown.

countries.name: South Africa
countries.rentalTip: Avis/Europcar/Tempest issue 24h breakdown stickers on windscreen — call before arranging private tow
countries.medivac: Via travel insurer — Netcare 911, Mediclinic, or Life Healthcare private hospitals in major cities

countries.name: Namibia
countries.rentalTip: Namibia2Go and Asco include breakdown support numbers on rental agreement — photograph before leaving depot
countries.medivac: Medical evacuation to Windhoek or Johannesburg — insurance mandatory for Skeleton Coast routes

countries.name: Botswana
countries.roadside: Limited national AA — lodge or rental operator dispatch from Maun/Kasane
countries.rentalTip: Delta breakdowns require lodge radio or satellite phone — do not leave vehicle in deep sand
countries.medivac: Okavango air ambulance via insurer; serious cases to Johannesburg

countries.name: Zambia
countries.roadside: AA Zambia +260 211 251 958 · local garage tow common on Great North Road
countries.rentalTip: Livingstone rentals often partner with Vic Falls mechanics — keep company number handy
countries.medivac: Proflight or charter medivac from Luangwa — confirm cover before bushcamp stays

countries.name: Zimbabwe
countries.ambulance: 994 · private clinics Victoria Falls and Harare
countries.roadside: AA Zimbabwe +263 4 779 220 · informal tow trucks at Beitbridge — agree price first
countries.rentalTip: Fuel shortages can strand you — AA or rental before accepting random tow at border
countries.medivac: Victoria Falls to Johannesburg common route — carry insurance hotline on paper

countries.name: Mozambique
countries.roadside: Limited — rental company or lodge on EN1; 4×4 communities help on sand tracks
countries.rentalTip: Lebombo breakdowns — call SA rental if vehicle registered there; document police report for insurance
countries.medivac: Maputo or Nelspruit/Mbombela — insurance essential for northern coast

countries.name: Malawi
countries.roadside: Local garage tow — no national AA equivalent; lodge assistance on lake routes
countries.rentalTip: Carry spare tyre and jack — rural tow can take hours
countries.medivac: Lilongwe or Blantyre private hospitals; serious cases to Johannesburg

countries.name: Lesotho
countries.roadside: SA AA may assist near border — Sani Pass recovery is specialist 4×4
countries.rentalTip: Sani Pass descent breakdowns — Sani Mountain Lodge or Underberg operators; do not block single-track
countries.medivac: Maseru Queen 'Mamohato Hospital; serious trauma to Bloemfontein or JNB

countries.name: Eswatini
countries.roadside: Often routed via SA AA from Oshoek — Big Game Parks radio for Hlane/Mkhaya
countries.rentalTip: Compact country — most breakdowns within tow range of Mbabane garages
countries.medivac: Mbabane Clinic or transfer to Durban/Johannesburg

satelliteDevices.title: When cell signal fails
satelliteDevices.body: Namibia north of Etosha, Gonarezhou, southern Lesotho highlands, and remote Mozambique coast have no reliable GSM. Consider Garmin inReach, Zoleo, or rental satellite phone for multi-day remote legs — share tracking link with family.
bullets: Download offline maps before leaving last town with data
Share itinerary dates with lodge — they radio for help when guests overdue
SAT phone hire available in Windhoek and Johannesburg before departure
